projects.name: Dhara – Indian Folk Art Digital Marketplace
highlights: Developed a full-stack digital marketplace connecting Indian folk artists with buyers, featuring artist profiles, category-based artwork galleries, and real-time search and filtering for intuitive discovery.

Implemented secure JWT-based authentication with bcrypt password hashing and role-based access control, along with protected routes enabling artists to manage uploads and buyers to browse and interact seamlessly.

projects.name: SmartWallet – Wallet Management System
highlights: Architected a full-stack digital wallet supporting atomic peer-to-peer and merchant payments using MySQL stored procedures, preventing partial-update failures and duplicate charges through transaction-hash idempotency.
Designed 5+ MySQL triggers and stored procedures with wallet audit trails, bcrypt-based PIN hashing, JWT authentication, and role-based access control for users and merchants.
Built automated reward-expiry handling using MySQL scheduled events, monthly analytics with CSV export and chart visualizations, and hourly refund-retry logic.
